_comment: Console serving. The page is a single self-contained HTML file that works over file://
as a labelled static snapshot; console.py adds live polling when it is running.
It binds 127.0.0.1 only, checks the Host header (DNS-rebinding), and serves ONLY the
console directory plus the explicit read allowlist below - never the repo root, which
would expose .env and everything else on localhost. Port "auto" derives a stable
per-project port from the repo folder name (7100-7899); an explicit integer overrides
it, decided once per project. monitor.enabled turns on the live system strip (CPU,
RAM, GPU) on the NOW tab - live-only, never in snapshots; kits ship it off.
The architecture diagram (mapctl architecture -> system-map/architecture.json and
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). scopes: one diagram each; source cards builds from the system-map
cards, source code from graphctl.py when installed (skipped with a WARN otherwise).
max_nodes: past it, a group's least-connected boxes fold into one 'other' box.
